test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

By the time his friends woke up, he had already __begun __his journey.
solution:
The solution is **No substitution required.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **No substitution required **for the underlined segment in the given sentence.
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Substitution** of words **helps to avoid repetition of words in a sentence.**
 
• Sometimes substitution helps in showing the word more effortlessly.
